author: WiggleJiggle
body:
To, Avicus Staff

My friend Abhi (aka Blitzem) was at my house for a sleep over. Since he was banned from Avicus I let him use my computer to play on it. He wanted to get unbanned REALLY badly and tried to use my account to tell you guys that you should un ban his account. So I ended up getting banned for "Ban Evading" though I was not. So I would like to please get unbanned from your server. Thank you have a nice day.

From, Suodoku

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

You said, "I let him use my computer to play on it." That technically means that he was ban evading on your account as it was still him playing on it. Your account, your responsibility. If he wanted to get unbanned, then he should have made an appeal instead of using your account to ban evade.

You may create an appeal regarding this situation in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled
